_note: Drafted by Mark with Max (lines may change). Parties' lines become the claim and filings; the whole script is in _script. The relief line isn't in the script.
_script: Max: Cereal is food floating in liquid in a bowl, so cereal is soup.
Gpa: Soup is hot, and nobody eats soup for breakfast.
Max: Not all soup is hot. There are dessert soups that are cold, so cereal is a dessert soup.
Gpa: If it's a soup, then why do they call it cereal?
title: The Great Cereal Question
claim: Cereal is food floating in liquid in a bowl, so cereal is soup.
relief: The court declares that cereal is soup.
